title: import_request_schema.json
description: Body of POST /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/fleet-observe/imports (TRAIG-179). Field names are the API server's own. Closed: unknown keys are a 400. source_kind lists the producer states the API server accepts in Observe v1; the reserved mediated_enforcement_connector is rejected. observed_at has a future-skew bound only (5 minutes, API server-enforced). The canonical request digest and the derived idempotency_key are specified in data/fleet_observe/request_digest_v1.md.

retention_class.description: Optional; the API server applies ledger_minimal when absent.

ImportMember.description: One imported principal, credential or workload by digest. parent_member_digest is optional and may be explicit null (same as omitted); when a digest, it must differ from member_digest. Not expressible in JSON Schema and enforced by the API server (closed 400): one member_digest with two different parents in one request; a parent cycle inside one request. Exact duplicate members collapse server-side.
